column1: # Reviewed semantic identities for GAME player-vitals adjustment, state initialization, and the two-phase death transition.
# Every row was checked with kf sema addr/disasm --blocks/xref/xref --callees/strings, Ghidra candidates,
# callers and adjacent boundaries, source/history/match state, and FID/vendor controls. The visual helpers are a
# call-graph dependency expansion of the 0x80015164..0x800156bc pilot band, not a translation-unit ownership claim.

column7: called by the HP clamp, the zero-HP player-update path, and fatal map-hazard handling; writes player_death_saved_color_matrix and player_death_saved_fog_near; no strings
column8: no argument register is consumed and no return value escapes
column9: absent from vendored/FID inventories; it coordinates game player, sound, fog, and GTE state
column12: supported; entry effect and state transition are direct, while the original source symbol and TU remain unknown
